personal.profileSummary: I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at Lovely Professional University with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, NLP, and intelligent automation. I have hands-on experience developing AI/ML projects involving predictive analytics, feature engineering, Transformer-based models, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). My projects include a Tropical Cyclone Formation and Intensity Prediction system, an Automatic MCQ Quiz Generator using Generative AI, and DocSensei, an intelligent PDF/DOCX question-answering system. I am also developing my knowledge of LLMs, Agentic AI, prompt engineering, AI agents, LangChain, and API-based AI applications, with a focus on building practical and impactful intelligent solutions.

projects.title: Tropical Cyclone Formation & Intensity Prediction
projects.subtitle: Predictive Analytics for Disaster Preparedness
highlights: Developed a machine learning-based system to predict tropical cyclone formation and intensity using historical meteorological and atmospheric datasets.
Performed comprehensive data pre-processing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis to identify important patterns influencing cyclone development.
Applied predictive analytics to support early warning systems, cyclone risk assessment, and improved disaster preparedness and response planning.

projects.title: Automatic MCQ Quiz Generator Using Generative AI
projects.subtitle: NLP & Transformer-Based Assessment Automation
highlights: Developed an AI-powered system to automatically generate multiple-choice questions, answer keys, and explanations from uploaded educational learning materials.
Applied NLP and Transformer-based models, including T5 and BART, to generate contextually relevant and meaningful assessment questions.
Designed the solution to support personalized learning, automated assessments, and efficient generation of practice quizzes for students.

projects.title: Doc Sensei – Intelligent PDF & DOCX Question Answering System
projects.subtitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Document QA
highlights: Developed an AI-powered document question-answering system using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide accurate, context-aware responses from uploaded documents.
Implemented document chunking, text embeddings, semantic search, and vector storage using ChromaDB to enable efficient and relevant information retrieval.
Deployed the application on Streamlit Community Cloud, allowing users to upload documents and interactively query their content through a conversational interface.

training.title: AI Engineer Launchpad: Mastering LLMs and Agentic AI
highlights: Completed a structured AI engineering course focused on Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Developed foundational understanding of LLM applications, prompt engineering, AI agents, and agentic workflows through guided learning and practical exercises.
Strengthened skills in designing AI-powered solutions and automation workflows using modern generative AI concepts.
